subject: Human Evolution
title: Venus Figurines
description: A short lesson to help you apply Venus Figurines.

hook.text: Small carved women with exaggerated features appear across Europe from 40,000 to 11,000 years ago.

buildup.text: The Venus of Willendorf, only 11 cm tall, has no face but prominent breasts and belly.

discovery.text: These figurines may represent fertility, motherhood, or idealized body types—interpretations vary.

twist.text: Some scholars argue they're self-portraits: women looking down at their own bodies from above.

climax.text: Whatever their meaning, they're proof of shared symbolic traditions spanning thousands of miles and years.

punchline.text: Tiny carvings held big shared ideas.

quiz.question: What might Venus figurines represent?
options: Fertility, motherhood, or shared symbolic tradition
